data.pre: THE BIGGEST VILLAIN ARC IN FOOTBALL

beats.say: Some footballers don't just leave their club.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: They come back as the villain.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: One of them cost a world-record thirty-seven million pounds to cross the biggest divide in football.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Two years later, his old fans threw a pig's head at him.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: We tracked ten of the biggest rival moves in modern football:
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: the fees, the timing, and what happened next.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: We start with a leak on the eve of a semi-final,
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: pass a billboard that broke a city,
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: and finish at the Camp Now, with a pig's head.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Number ten. Mario Goetze.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: He was Dortmund's golden boy. Twenty years old, raised by the club, the future of the team.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Then, on the twenty-third of April, twenty thirteen, a German newspaper ran four words on its front page.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Goetze to Byern.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: The next night, Dortmund had a Champions League semi-final against Real Madrid. So why did the timing hurt so much?
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Because Byern didn't negotiate. They paid his thirty-seven million euro buyout clause.
beats.speaker: P

beats.say: Dortmund had no say. And Byern were the exact team they were trying to knock off the top of Germany.
beats.speaker: P

beats.say: Dortmund answered the leak the only way they could. They beat Real Madrid four, one.
beats.speaker: P

beats.say: And one striker scored all four.
beats.speaker: P

beats.say: A month later, Dortmund met Byern in the final at Wembley.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Byern won, two, one. Goetze watched it injured.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: And that striker who scored all four?
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: A year later, he made the exact same move. For free.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Dortmund had turned him into a star. Byern collected the goals.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Three hundred and forty-four of them, in eight seasons.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: In one season he scored forty-one in the Bundesliga, equalling Gerd Mueller's record.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: But Lewandowski never said it was about money. Number eight did.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Number eight. Ashley Cole.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: He came through Arsenal's academy, and played left-back for the team that went a whole league season unbeaten.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Then Arsenal offered him a new contract. Fifty-five thousand pounds a week.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: He felt it was far below his worth, and joined Chelsea.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Arsenal fans had a new name for him. Cashley.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Number seven. Carlos Tevez.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Two seasons at Manchester United. Then he crossed the city to Manchester City.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: City put him on a giant blue billboard. Three words. Welcome to Manchester.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Tevez left to compete with his old club. Number six left to beat them.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Number six. Robin van Persie.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: He was Arsenal's captain. In August twenty twelve, Manchester United paid twenty-two and a half million pounds for him.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: So why did this one hurt more than the others?
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Because he didn't just leave. He scored twenty-six league goals in his first season.
beats.speaker: P

beats.say: Manchester United won the title. Arsenal finished fourth.
beats.speaker: P

beats.say: Number five. Luis Enrique.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Five seasons at Real Madrid. Then, in nineteen ninety-six, he signed for Barcelona.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: He stayed eight seasons. Years later he came back as their coach, and won the treble.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Number four. Sol Campbell.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: He came through Tottenham's ranks and spent nine years there.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Then, in July two thousand and one, he walked across North London to Arsenal. For free.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: At Arsenal he won two league titles, three FA Cups,
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: and went a whole season unbeaten.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: The top three crossed the biggest lines in world football.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Number three. Gonzalo Higuain.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: In his last season at Napoli, he scored thirty-six Serie A goals.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: That broke a league record that had stood for sixty-six years. So why did Naples turn on him?
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Because weeks later, Juventus paid his ninety million euro release clause.
beats.speaker: P

beats.say: The most expensive transfer in Italian history. To Napoli's biggest rival.
beats.speaker: P

beats.say: Number two. The original Ronaldo.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: He played for Barcelona, then Inter,
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: then Real Madrid, then AC Milan.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Two of football's biggest rivalries, and he played on both sides of each.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: In March twenty oh seven, in Milan's red and black, he scored against Inter. His old club.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Inter still won, two, one.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Number one. Luis Figo.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: He was Barcelona's best player.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: In July two thousand, Real Madrid made him the most expensive footballer in the world.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: So how do you steal your biggest rival's best player?
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: With a promise. Florentino Perez was running to be Real Madrid's president.
beats.speaker: P

beats.say: He promised the members Figo. And if he failed, he would pay for their season tickets.
beats.speaker: P

beats.say: He won. And Figo came.
beats.speaker: P

beats.say: Two years later, Figo went back to the Camp Now, in white.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Every time he went to take a corner, things rained down from the stands.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Including a pig's head.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: That's the biggest villain arc in football.
beats.speaker: H

beats.say: Who would you put at number one? Tell us in the comments.
beats.speaker: H
